author: Ségolène Le Stradic
summary: The suspect, identified only as Kévin T., admitted to planning the attacks near Paris last week, the prosecutor said. One person was killed and seven wounded.

title: Russian Strike on Ukrainian Train Station Kills 14
author: Cassandra Vinograd
summary: A deadly strike was a grim reminder that despite a rare local cease-fire around the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, other communities remained under fire.

title: Hong Kong Leader Apologizes for Deadly Apartment Building Fire
author: Alexandra Stevenson
summary: John Lee, the city’s chief executive, said his housing secretary would step down, but he vehemently defended the government.
